ios.desc:
Experience the power of cartomancy with TAROT TRANSFORMER's state-of-the-art on-device artificial intelligence. Get your daily tarot readings with the Rider Waite deck and on-device Llama 3.2. With on-device artificial intelligence, your privacy is always protected.

TAROT TRANSFORMER is an innovative app that combines the mystique of tarot readings with the convenience of on-device artificial intelligence. Powered by the state-of-the-art on-device artificial intelligence this app offers a unique and immersive experience for tarot enthusiasts.

What sets TAROT TRANSFORMER apart from other tarot apps is its integration of the Rider Waite tarot card deck and the use of on device AI for unparalleled accuracy in readings.

The privacy and security of user data is of utmost importance to the TAROT TRANSFORMER team. The app is designed to handle all data processing on-device, ensuring that sensitive information remains private and secure. The use of state-of-the-art on-device AI for readings also ensures that no data is transmitted to external servers, providing a high level of trust and confidence for the user.

With TAROT TRANSFORMER users can enjoy a truly immersive and personalized tarot experience with the added benefit of privacy and security. Experience the magic of the Rider Waite tarot deck like never before with TAROT TRANSFORMER - download now and unlock the secrets of your future!

quotes.text:
Backstory: Originally conceived as an augmented reality tarot app circa 2016, rebranded as an AI tarot reading app August '23 with on-device Vicuna-v1.5-7B but even with 3bit quantization the model required at least 4GB ram to run inference which limited the app to iPhone14 while still prone to out-of-memory crashes and chat functionality that was limited to devices with at least 8GB.

This most recent update/rebrand introduces RWKV-Raven-3b reducing the memory requirement to under 3Gb making the app with full chat usable on iPhone 12 and above at the cost of generated output quality. Given its size the performance of RWKV-Raven-3B is quite impressive.

https://wiki.rwkv.com/
